description: This file defines a Spring configuration class for setting up Swagger API documentation in a banking application. It configures a Docket bean with API info and path selection.

classes.name: ApplicationConfig
classes.description: Spring configuration class that enables Swagger 2 documentation and defines a Docket bean for API documentation setup.

methods.name: api
methods.description: Creates and configures a Docket bean for Swagger 2 API documentation, including API info and path selection.

methods.name: apiInfo
methods.description: Constructs the ApiInfo object containing API metadata such as title, description, and version.
